claim: The native Classic dispatcher of BolgeForge (dest = op(rot^r(op(a, c)), 48)) can select N=3 distinct route addresses with a 27-cell gap, which is the arena size the native emitter needs per route. The address-collapse blocker measured for 100 product recipes does not apply to N=3.

method.description: Exhaustive sweep over the branch constant c (33..126) and the rotation count r (0..15). For N contiguous source opcodes (48..48+N-1) the destination is dest = op(rot^r(op(a, c)), 48). A combination is valid when it yields N distinct destinations with gap >= 20 cells.
method.crazy_rot: re-derived locally (identical semantics to BolgeForge/constants.py, methodology only)
method.reference_blocker: BolgeForge docs/evidence/2026-10-22-product-0-9-negative/README.md: 100 packed addresses collapse to 56 unique after the branch

interpretation: The 27-cell gap matches the per-route arena of the native emitter (setup 3k+3 plus a recipe of at most 26 cells), so N=3 routes are individually placeable.
The blocker documented for the 100-recipe product target is an artefact of N=100, not of the dispatcher.
N=3 keeps 31 valid (c, r) combinations, so the choice is not tight.
what_this_does_not_demonstrate: That the three routes can be placed simultaneously with disjoint arenas (this sweep is per-route arithmetic only; a real build needs the disjoint backtracking of select_options).
That any route can load a byte-code program into RAM: the native emitter is a rectilinear-recipe dispatcher and has no notion of a stored-program PC.
That the resulting image passes the strict loader (mb_ref) - that is the next gate.
scope_limits: Only the address-packing arithmetic is measured here; no image is emitted.
Branch constant c is restricted to printable bytes (33..126) and rotations to 0..15.
Source opcodes are the contiguous range 48..48+N-1, matching the emitter's '/' entry cell.
next_step: Build a minimal 2-route native image (ADD + CMP_EQ) with the (c=34, r=7) key and gate it with mb_ref plus the strict loader; that proves the hybrid path before attempting 3 routes.
